install_cmds: python -c "import torch, transformers; from transformers import AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoTokenizer; print('transformers', transformers.__version__, 'torch', torch.__version__)"

data_deps.name: text_simplification_model
data_deps.description: mrm8488/t5-base-finetuned-turk-text-simplification (a T5-base fine-tuned for sentence simplification; expects a 'simplify: ' prefix, ~220M params) staged offline. Model weights only -- NOT a leak concern (the model is the frozen inference target the agent decodes with, not an answer key). The three FIXED simplification test sets (source sentences + held-out human reference simplifications, re-serialised from GEM/wiki_auto_asset_turk) are deliberately NOT a data_dep / NOT baked into this base image: sources live agent-visible under vendor/text-simplification/_simp_data/ (checked into git, no references field), and references (the literal SARI answer key) are staged verifier-only under each tasks/simp-*/data/ dir, mounted at $TASK_DIR/data only at scoring time (see vendor/text-simplification/common.py::_refs_data_path and the tpp-neural-hawkes/ebm-langevin-cd precedent for this split). ~850MB (model only).
